description: This file implements the core game logic for a Tic Tac Toe game, encapsulating rules, game state management, and outcome evaluation without Android dependencies, designed for reuse and testing.

classes.name: GameEngine
classes.description: Contains game rules, state management, and logic for Tic Tac Toe, including player enum, game state data class, outcome sealed class, and methods for playing moves and starting new games.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Attempts to execute a move at a specified index, returning an updated game state if valid.

methods.name: newGame
methods.description: Creates a new game state with optional starting player.

methods.name: evaluateOutcome
methods.description: Checks the current board for win/draw conditions and returns the game outcome.
